Hi Emma + Sanjay —

Thanks again for the interest. We want to lock a 45-minute exec-level demo where your Product + CTO can join alongside our VP of Sales (Laura) and the infra lead (Jonas). Because this is a three-region hang (US west coast, central EU, APAC morning), we put together a small matrix below with DST caveats. The US will flip back on Nov 7; EU switches Nov 1 — that week is tricky.

Proposed 45-min windows (local times shown):
- Option A: 08:00 PDT / 16:00 CEST / 23:00 SGT (late APAC) — tighter for APAC execs
- Option B: 16:00 PDT / 00:00 CEST (next day) / 07:00 SGT — better for US afternoon but rough in EU
- Option C: 06:30 PDT / 15:30 CEST / 22:30 SGT — early for US but still within business hours elsewhere

Attachments: redwood_finthrive_exec_matrix_20271020.xlsx (time-zone grid + brief); briefing-notes.pdf (one-pager).

Can you confirm which option works for Emma and Sanjay, and whether either executive prefers a hard no for any of these slots? If needed, we can do a 30-min pre-brief with your PM before the exec slot.

If helpful, we can also run the 45-min session on Nov 9 (after both DST transitions) to avoid confusion — flag if you prefer waiting.

Best,
